ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark gray) to high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity central field extending from the peduncle to the trailing edge. High-intensity distal fields on the lateral tips of both lobes containing numerous isolated low-intensity circular geometric blobs (mottling).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central U-shaped depression with a narrow aperture and steep interior walls; approximately 30-degree internal angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary with pixel-amplitudes ranging from shallow ripples to prominent triangular peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge transitioning to a sharp upward sweep at the distal tips; leading edge exhibits a linear trajectory with slight convexity.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially dense clusters of circular dark pixel groups localized on the white-pigmented distal regions of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of at least four distinct, parallel diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) located on the upper-inner quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular textured masses at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, representing active barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Sparse high-intensity white speckling distributed across the lower-central dark pigmentation zone.
